01/ About

A developer who ships the whole thing, not just a slice.

I recently completed my Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Fazaia College of Education for Women, affiliated with Air University Islamabad. Across my degree I gravitated toward projects I could own from start to finish deciding the architecture, writing the code, and getting it working in the real world rather than on a slide.

On the web side, I build with React.js, Node.js and Express.js. On mobile, I develop native Android applications in Kotlin with Firebase for authentication, real-time data and messaging. My final year project paired both of those with IoT hardware, and an earlier project took me into embedded electronics sensors, circuitry and feedback systems for an assistive device.

I'm now looking for a full stack, web development, or Android development role or freelance and internship work where I can keep building complete, useful software.
